correctness.rationale: The source theorem makes the six-point resectioning ideal principal, generated by the square six-focal determinant. The relation-space construction gives two independent symbolic left-kernel vectors for every collinear image sextuple, forcing focal-matrix rank at most 16 and therefore vanishing of the determinant and all first derivatives. At the explicit collinear witness, exact symbolic arithmetic gives focal-matrix rank 16 and Hessian rank 4; the Hessian kernel equals the 8-dimensional tangent space of the collinearity locus, so the holomorphic Morse-Bott lemma gives the stated transverse ordinary-double-point normal form.
